answer: A submitter whose answers share 6 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 55% of its pending payouts meanwhile. The velvet detector writes each match to the marble queue, and the ripple checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
